messages:
aisha: quick heads-up — saw invoice diffs for a EU multi-tenant customer after last deploy. looks like our adaptive_hourly_watermark was applied to CCS-sampled events and rounding produced extra token counts. anyone else seeing?
ben: saw alert in dashboards. patchy: only tenants with CCS enabled + bursty short sessions.
marta: pinging infra. can you attach run id? what windowing logic changed?
aisha: run id: deploy-2026-03-18-67. example: tenant_42 had 0.4 tokens/hour moved to next hour repeatedly, accumulated to ~120 tokens.
samir: CC'ing @infra-bot for logs. suspect logic: watermarking uses percentiles to move watermark; CCS sampling upweights events -> effective duplication?
infra-bot: log snippet: "watermark_adjustment: +0.0031, sample_weight: 32, applied_to_shard: s3"
ben: here's SQL I ran to repro counts discrepancy:
```sql
select tenant_id, window_start, sum(tokens) as tokens, floor(sum(tokens)*100)/100 as rounded
from metering.events
where run_id = 'deploy-2026-03-18-67'
group by tenant_id, window_start
order by tenant_id, window_start limit 20;
```
marta: aha — rounding happens in post-agg for invoice lines. we store "tokens_rounded" as DECIMAL(2). watermarks cause micro-shifts in window attribution causing many small contributions to cross threshold and round up.
olivia: UX question: we expose per-hour line items in console; users noticed spikes. should we hide fractional rounding in UI? it might mask real issue though.
samir: priority: fix pipeline to ensure sampling weights applied before watermark calc and use deterministic bucketing so CCS and watermarking use same hash. patch suggestion in PR #5123.
aisha: can we backfill invoices for impacted tenants? estimate ~15 tenants, total diff ~$250. ops?
ben: finance flagged anything >$100 as require approval. I'll prep a spreadsheet.
marta: for immediate mitigation, disable adaptive_hourly_watermark for CCS-enabled tenants via flag "watermark.ccs_mode=false". rolling canary to 10% now?
aisha: go for canary. please add an alert to billing-dashboard for per-tenant hourly deltas >50 tokens.
infra-bot: deploy started: canary rollout 10% -> 100% (ETA 12m). logs show no regressed latency.
ben: filing incident ticket INC-2026-042 for tracking.
olivia: FYI adding a note in console changelog: "minor metering reconciliation" — will be careful wording.
samir: long-term: consider using integer-based token units and deterministic rounding at invoice aggregation, not per-window. also add unit tests to repro CCS+watermark.
aisha: thanks all. will pair on the backfill tomorrow. :thumbsup:
